primitives.note: Short Fuse periodically arms Ziggs's next basic attack with bonus magic damage (increased vs structures, not the dummy); cooldown starts on-attack.
Casting Q, W, E, or R reduces Short Fuse's remaining cooldown by a level-scaled flat amount (4-6s), granted at the start of the ability's cast time.
Bouncing Bomb and Mega Inferno Bomb deal a single AoE magic damage instance on landing/explosion, on cooldown.
Satchel Charge is thrown (initial cast, mana cost, counts as an ability activation) then recast (or auto-detonates after 4s) to deal its magic damage; recast is a separate timed part.

Q: whether the bomb's single explosion lands with the dummy in radius; E: how many of the 11 scattered mines make contact with a single stationary point target (drives how much of the 40%-subsequent-mine reduction applies); R: whether the dummy is assumed inside the 250-radius epicenter (full damage) or the outer ring (65% damage).
Mana costs (Q 50-70, W 80, E 70-110, R 100) constrain how many casts of each ability fit inside the ~15s fight given champion mana pool/regen.

needsBespoke.why: Every damage-relevant mechanic (Short Fuse's empowered-attack proc and per-cast cooldown refresh, Q/R's plain AoE landing damage, W's throw-then-recast structure, E's multi-mine field with diminishing subsequent-hit damage, R's epicenter/outer-ring falloff) is expressible as a combination of existing primitives; nothing requires bespoke engine logic beyond standard primitive composition plus the geometry assumptions already flagged as unsettled.

unsettled.question: How many of Hexplosive Minefield's 11 mines can realistically detonate on a single stationary point target, given each mine only explodes on contact within its own 135-unit trigger radius and the mines are spread over an inner ring (3 mines) and outer ring (8 mines, ~335 unit total spread)?
options: Only 1 mine ever contacts the target (full damage once, no reduced-damage mines)
The 3 inner-ring mines all contact the target if centered on it (1 full + 2 reduced-damage hits)
All 11 mines are assumed to contact the target (1 full + 10 reduced-damage hits, matching the wiki's stated 'Maximum Total Magic Damage' leveling row)
quotes: The mine cluster is built of 2 rings, with 3 mines in the inner ring (radius pending for test) and 8 mines on the other ring (200 radius), all equally spaced.
An enemy takes 40% damage from subsequent mines.

unsettled.question: Does Satchel Charge's recast (manual detonation) have its own cast time/animation lock that delays the next action, or is it effectively instantaneous relative to the 0.25s cast time of the initial throw?
options: Recast is instant (no additional delay before Ziggs can act/cast again)
Recast shares the same 0.25s cast time as the initial throw
Recast has its own unlisted animation delay not captured by either source
quotes: ''Satchel Charge'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.

unsettled.question: Is there a floor on Short Fuse's cooldown reduction from casting abilities (e.g., cannot go below 0 / cannot make the passive proc more than once per some minimum interval), given a rotation that casts Q (4-6s cooldown) rapidly could otherwise stack multiple seconds of CDR per second?
options: No floor beyond 0s remaining cooldown; rapid Q casts can make Short Fuse available almost immediately
There is an unstated minimum interval between Short Fuse procs not captured by either source
quotes: The cooldown reduction is granted at the start of the abilities' cast time.
{{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by {{pp|4 to 6 for 3|1 to 13}} seconds whenever '''Ziggs''' casts an {{tip|ability}}

proposal: Open by casting Q (Bouncing Bomb) aimed so its explosion lands on the dummy, both for damage and to trigger Short Fuse's cooldown reduction.
Follow immediately with E (Hexplosive Minefield) centered on the dummy to land as many mines' damage as the positional assumption allows.
Cast W (Satchel Charge) onto the dummy, then recast it immediately (rather than waiting out the 4s auto-detonate) to deal its damage sooner.
Cast R (Mega Inferno Bomb) aimed so the dummy sits inside the epicenter for full (non-reduced) damage.
Weave basic attacks between every cast so that whenever Short Fuse comes off cooldown its empowered bonus damage lands as soon as possible.
Recast Q on cooldown (lowest cooldown ability, 4-6s) for the remainder of the 15s window, interleaving E and another W cast if their cooldowns (16s / 12-20s) come up in time.
Cast R a second time only if its cooldown (70-120s) has actually elapsed within the 15s window (unlikely except at very high rank with haste).
questions: Should basic attacks be modeled at all in the damage fight, or is only the ability-cast sequence scored (this changes whether Short Fuse's empowered-attack primitive matters)?
At what champion level and ability ranks is the rotation evaluated, since Short Fuse's per-cast CDR tier (4/5/6s) and all base damages scale with level/rank?
For Q, is the dummy assumed to be hit on the first bounce (fastest, closest) or should travel time to a farther bounce be modeled, and does that materially change the 15s cast count?
What positional assumption should be locked in for E's mine-hit-count, since it swings E's total damage contribution the most of any ability?
